weeks.title: Core Architecture, Execution Context & Modern ES6+ Systems
weeks.description: Understand JavaScript runtime engines, call stacks, event loops, memory lifecycle, and clean code patterns for scalable engineering.
learningObjectives: Execution Context, Call Stack & Microtask Queue
Memory Allocation, Garbage Collection & Leak Prevention
Modern ES6+ Modules, Iterators & Immutable Data Patterns

weeks.title: Component Architecture, Reactive State & High-Performance UI
weeks.description: Design composable component hierarchies, understand virtual DOM diffing, master custom state hooks, and optimize rendering pipelines.
learningObjectives: Custom Hook Factories & Fine-Grained State Primitives
Render Tree Profiling, Memoization & Layout Shifts

weeks.title: Backend Architecture, Edge Services & High-Performance REST
weeks.description: Build production-grade server endpoints, handle streaming requests, design robust API contracts, and leverage edge middleware.

weeks.title: Relational Databases, PostgreSQL Modeling & ACID Transactions
weeks.description: Master relational schema modeling, foreign key constraints, indexes, connection pooling, and multi-step ACID transactions.
learningObjectives: Indexes: B-Tree, Hash, GIN & Query Planners

weeks.title: Authentication, Role-Based Access Control & Web Security Hardening
weeks.description: Implement defense-in-depth security: JWTs, secure HTTP-only cookie sessions, CSRF/XSS defenses, rate limiting, and RLS.
learningObjectives: Token Mechanics: Refresh & Access Token Lifecycles
Threat Mitigation: CSRF, XSS, SSRF & Injection
Row Level Security (RLS) & Granular RBAC Gates

weeks.title: Real-Time Synchronization, WebSockets & Distributed Caching
weeks.description: Implement duplex communication channels, handle optimistic UI updates, and design multi-tiered Redis caching strategies.

weeks.title: Automated Testing, CI/CD Pipelines & Containerized Environments
weeks.description: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; configure GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, Docker containers, and artifact validation.
learningObjectives: Test-Driven Design: Unit, Integration & Contract Testing

weeks.title: Capstone Architecture, Production Observability & Performance Audits
weeks.description: Bring everything together into a scalable capstone project. Perform Core Web Vitals audits, configure OpenTelemetry, and deploy.
learningObjectives: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) Optimization
Final Production Audit, Security Checklist & Launch
